provenance.scope: Historical measured file durations; scheduling estimates, not current-source validation.

fast_refresh.includes: Per-file process startup; files executed concurrently within one cluster task.

fast_command_measurement.includes: Serial fresh test process per file and process startup; excludes cluster staging and queue.

provenance.selection: Only current publicly selected test files are retained; remaining source files use the conservative unknown duration.

integration_refresh.includes: Files new to the integration branch, measured once on the cluster in 10 concurrent shards with per-file process startup; the failures are the recorded wave-A baseline, not current-source validation.

integration_refresh_b.includes: Files that ran green in the wave-B regeneration check; the non-compliance and canary files that did not run to completion on the cluster keep the conservative unknown duration.

integration_refresh_c.includes: Files without an entry, measured once on the cluster in 10 concurrent shards with per-file process startup. Files that failed or did not finish keep the conservative unknown duration; this measures duration, it does not validate the sources.

ci_refresh.source: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 run 39699325477 at commit 4cea1e6
ci_refresh.includes: Wall seconds per file on the hosted runner for files that ran before the shard jobs were cancelled; other files are the cluster seconds multiplied by the hosted/cluster ratio over files recorded in both. A file stopped at its file limit is recorded at that limit and runs in a dedicated long job.
